title: Rent Spike
description: The landlord association announces a 40% rent hike across the district, citing inflation. Residents are holding an emergency meeting.

title: Grid Failure
description: A transformer blew and the south block has been dark for two days. The utility company says repairs will take a week.

title: Mass Eviction
description: Three families received eviction notices. A developer wants to convert the block to luxury condos.

scapegoat.label: Stay quiet, negotiate your own deal

title: Corner Store Closure
description: The only affordable grocery in the district closed overnight. A chain store is offering to fill the space — at twice the prices.

title: Sweeps & Displacement
description: City authorities announce a 'clean-up operation' targeting unhoused neighbors in the park.
